findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `isRestricted_pi_iff` fires on any goal whose coefficient type is syntactically a pi (including the intended `Fin n → N` finite-free case) and rewrites into `∀ i, IsRestricted (fun s ↦ f s i)`. By the author's own transparency note in BaseChange.lean:91-95, simp cannot unfold `MvPowerSeries`, so neither `Pi.zero_apply` nor `isRestricted_zero`/`isRestricted_monomial`/`isRestricted_of_hasFiniteSupport` can match the result — a previously simp-closable goal such as `IsRestricted (0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin k) (∀ i, M i))` can be left stuck.

summary: Both new declarations use the `show MvPowerSeries … from …` ascription and close at full transparency with no inline comment, breaking the file's own convention of documenting each defeq bridge; the `@[simp]` on `isRestricted_pi_iff` also rewrites into a form no other lemma in the file can match.
